packages/Common.reason: zod has no fixed 3.x release: every version below 4.6.6 is affected and 3.25.76 is the latest 3.x. Common's zod 3 comes from botbuilder 4.23.3, the latest (botbuilder-core, botframework-connector and botframework-schema require zod ^3.23.8), from @asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi 7, and from Common's own Utils/Schema, which builds the OpenAPI document and the MCP tools' schemas from the models and parses nothing with them. The advisory's memory exhaustion is in parsing an array schema with no length limit, which keeps an issue for every failing element. botbuilder's only parse of an incoming request is z.record(z.unknown()) on the activity (CloudAdapter.process), which has no array schema and cannot fail per element, and its other zod uses read its own configuration and credentials. App's zod 4 (the MCP SDK's, which validates tool arguments) is upgraded to 4.6.7. Moving Common to zod 4 is a follow-up.

packages/MobileApp.reason: zod has no fixed 3.x release: every version below 4.6.6 is affected and 3.25.76 is the latest 3.x. It comes in only through Expo's developer tooling, @expo/cli 57.0.32 (the latest @expo/cli still requires zod ^3.25.76), which runs in Node on the developer's machine and is not bundled into the app. It validates the developer's own project configuration, never input from an attacker.
